About this property

Comfortable Accommodations: Ananthyam Resort by Anukulas in Yelagiri offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, and free toiletries. Each room includes a TV, soundproofing, and a work desk. Exceptional Facilities: Guests can enjoy a fitness centre, year-round outdoor swimming pool, and a lush garden. The resort features a hot tub, 24-hour front desk, and free WiFi throughout. Dining Experience: The family-friendly restaurant serves buffet, à la carte, vegetarian, and halal meals for lunch, dinner, and high tea. Additional amenities include a barbecue area and a pool with a view. Convenient Location: Situated 140 km from Salem Airport, the resort offers free on-site private parking and is near Murugan Temple.

Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8.8 for a two-person trip.
